fields.label: Event story
fields.sample:
The little bistro we’ve dreamed of for years is finally opening its doors. We want to be a warm corner for the neighborhood’s morning coffee, lunch breaks and evening conversations.
Our menu features seasonal produce, bread from our own oven and handmade desserts. We can’t wait to meet you and get to know you on opening day.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample: Thank you so much for being with us on our first day. Our door is always open — come by for a coffee anytime!

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
The corner shop that sat empty for years is shin­ing again after months of ren­o­va­tion. When the cover came off the window, the neigh­bors all asked the same ques­tion: “When does it open?” The answer is on this page.
The founders say the menu fea­tures sea­son­al pro­duce, bread from their own oven and hand­made desserts. Aiming to become the neighborhood’s meet­ing spot from morn­ing coffee to evening con­ver­sa­tion, the team will greet ev­ery­one at the door on open­ing day.
According to the mer­chants’ as­so­ci­a­tion, the long­est line on the street is ex­pect­ed to form out­side this door on open­ing day. The clip-and-bring dis­count coupon is on the inside pages.

elements.name: Cevap

elements.name: Ulaşım
elements.text: Five min­utes’ walk from the ferry pier. The bus stop is at the top of the street, with bike park­ing by the door. Driv­ing? Take public tran­sit in­stead: the street is narrow, and the neigh­bors are pa­tient, but even pa­tience has its limits.

elements.text: Wanted: a friendly team member with a sharp memory who loves saying “Enjoy your meal.”

elements.text: Won’t be needed if the founders lose their bet. Applications open for now.

elements.name: İlan Tadımcı
elements.text: Volunteer to try new recipes first and deliver criticism sweetly. Pay: one smile per plate.

elements.name: İlan Kurye

elements.name: İlan Hikâye anlatıcısı
elements.text: A retired neighbor to visit tables at Sunday breakfast, telling tales of the old neighborhood.

elements.name: İlan Müzisyen
elements.text: Volunteer to play acoustic sets on Sunday mornings, paid in coffee.

elements.name: İlan Hiçbir şey
elements.text: Here everything is enjoyed fresh; nothing is sold, only shared.

elements.name: İlan Eski tabela
elements.text: The shop’s previous sign. High sentimental value, even higher weight.

elements.name: İlan Vişne reçeli
elements.text: Homemade. Bring back the jar and get the next one at half price.

elements.name: İlan Ekşi maya
elements.text: Heart of our bakery. Not for sale, but a spoonful is yours if you ask.

elements.name: İlan Hediye çeki
elements.text: Breakfast gift vouchers for birthdays and “so glad you’re in my life” days.

elements.name: İlan Tarif
elements.text: Our lemonade recipe isn’t for sale, but it may be whispered to anyone who insists.

elements.name: İlan Pencere kenarı
elements.text: The best table. Yours if you arrive before nine.

elements.name: İlan Kitap rafı
elements.text: Leave a book, take a book. Rent: one recommendation.

elements.name: İlan Uzun masa
elements.text: Seats twelve; for birthdays, meetings and family meals, by reservation.

elements.name: İlan Teras köşesi
elements.text: A table for two at sunset. High demand, long wait.

elements.name: İlan Şarj prizi
elements.text: Free for two hours if you’re working on a laptop; after that, one coffee.

elements.name: İlan Bisiklet yeri
elements.text: Three bikes fit by the door; we’ll make room for a fourth.

elements.name: İlan Diyet
elements.text: Lost in front of the dessert case on opening day. Finder need not return it.

elements.name: İlan Şemsiye
elements.text: Every umbrella in the neighborhood will end up here someday; we keep them safe.

elements.name: İlan Tek eldiven
elements.text: Waiting at the register. Bring its match for a discounted coffee.

elements.name: İlan Sabır
elements.text: Lost while waiting for warm pastries to come out of the oven.

elements.name: İlan Zaman
elements.text: Slipped away unnoticed during a chat by the window.

elements.name: İlan Kalem
elements.text: Pens lost signing at the register. They all come back someday.

elements.name: İlan Duyuru
elements.text: Food and water are always ready by the door for the neighborhood cats.

elements.name: İlan Rica
elements.text: Don’t let your coffee go cold while taking photos; the foam won’t wait.

elements.name: İlan Askıda kahve
elements.text: Pay for an extra coffee so a neighbor in need can have one.

elements.name: İlan Pazar kahvaltısı
elements.text: Every Sunday with live music; reservations recommended.

elements.name: İlan Emanet
elements.text: Forgotten books, glasses and hearts are kept at the register.

elements.name: İlan Kitap kulübü
elements.text: First Tuesday evening of the month. Read or not, come chat.

elements.name: Resmî ilan metni
elements.text: Notice is hereby given that our es­tab­lish­ment, to op­er­ate on this street, will open its doors on the date stated above; that neigh­bor­hood res­i­dents, our fellow mer­chants and our four-legged friends are in­vit­ed to the open­ing; and that, fol­low­ing the ribbon cut­ting, re­fresh­ments will be served until they run out.

elements.name: Teşekkür ilanı
elements.text: Heartfelt thanks to all our neighbors who put up with our dust, noise and curiosity during the renovation. The first coffees are on us!
